Customize Holocene Data Assimilation Parameters




To create a Holocene reconstruction, adjust the options below and click "submit." You will receive an email when your reconstruction is done.

For more information about each of the options, mouse over the question mark icons or see Erb et al. 2022 for more details. Default values will produce a reconstruction similar to the one in Erb et al., 2022. If you are unsure what an option does, leaving it at its default value is a good choice.








? The experiment name, which will be appended to the filename. Pick something short & memorable, using only letters, numbers, and underscores (no spaces).


? The variables to reconstruct {['tas']}. Note, only tas is fully supported at the moment.
